definitions.gloss: lake surface; surface of a lake
definitions.explanation: The surface of a lake. Often used in descriptive or literary contexts when discussing the appearance, conditions, or reflections on a lake.

examples.japanese: {湖面|こめん}に{山|やま}が{映|うつ}っている。
examples.english: The mountains are reflected on the lake surface.

examples.japanese: {朝日|あさひ}に{照|て}らされた{湖面|こめん}が{金色|きんいろ}に{輝|かがや}いていた。
examples.english: The lake surface, lit by the morning sun, was shining golden.

notes:
A compound of {湖|みずうみ} (lake) and {面|めん} (surface). Follows the same pattern as other surface-related compounds: {海面|かいめん} (sea surface), {水面|すいめん} (water surface), {路面|ろめん} (road surface).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湖面|こめん}に{映|うつ}る — to be reflected on the lake surface
- {湖面|こめん}が{凍|こお}る — the lake surface freezes
- {湖面|こめん}が{波立|なみだ}つ — the lake surface ripples
- {湖面|こめん}を{渡|わた}る{風|かぜ} — wind crossing the lake surface

RELATED WORDS:
- {水面|すいめん}/{水面|みなも} — water surface; general term for any body of water's surface
- {海面|かいめん} — sea surface
- {湖|みずうみ} — lake; the body of water itself
- {湖畔|こはん} — lakeside; the shore area around a lake
